recipes.name: Overnight Salad inspired by Saturday Night Live
instructions: For the SNL Overnight Salad Method (Don’t Make This):
In a large bowl, fill the bottom with a little bit of lettuce followed by a sprinkling of cubed cheddar cheese and the juice of one lemon. - Shredded lettuce - Cheddar cheese cubed - 1 lemon
Add in enough mayonnaise to cover the cheese and enough that will hold 25 standing halved hot dogs. - Mayonnaise - 25 Hot Dogs halved
On top of the hot dogs, cover with two handfuls of raisins and enough freshly ground black pepper to cover the raisins. - 2 handfuls raisins - Freshly ground black pepper
Top with Fritos, and pour in enough root beer to cover the standing hot dogs. - Fritos - Root Beer

Add the cookies to the top before topping with a few slices of pizza and one final dollop of mayonnaise with a cherry on top. I do not recommend making or consuming this! - Cookies - Pizza - Mayonnaise - Maraschino cherry for garnish

Start by combining egg, mustard, a pinch of salt, and the lemon juice in an immersion blender jar. Slowly pour neutral-flavored oil (i.e. canola oil) and blend until a thick emulsion forms. You now have homemade mayo! - 1 egg - 1 tsp mustard - 1 lemon - Kosher salt - 1 cup neutral flavored oil

Into a large bowl, combine the homemade mayo with chili sauce, prepared horseradish, hot sauce, Worcestershire sauce, sweet paprika, and a couple of tablespoons of finely minced onion. Whisk to combine. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. This makes your Russian salad dressing. - ⅓ cup chili oil - 3 tbsp horseradish - 1 tsp hot sauce - 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce - 1 tsp sweet paprika - 2 tbsp finely minced onion

To make croutons, cube up a bunch of rye bread. Place on a rimmed baking sheet and drizzle generously with olive oil. Sprinkle with kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper and toss together, spread out, and bake at 300°F for 20-40 minutes. - Rye bread cubed
Slice deli pastrami into thin little bits - Deli pastrami thinly sliced
Shred a ton of swiss cheese along with chopped purple cabbage before assembling. - Purple cabbage chopped - Swiss cheese shredded

For assembly, start the bottom layer with some purple cabbage, then top with arugula, swiss cheese, and an optional sprinkle of cornichon chopped pickles. - Purple cabbage chopped - Swiss cheese shredded - Arugula - Cornichon pickles chopped (optional)

Top the pickles with a generous amount of the sliced pastrami, some more swiss, and another layer of arugula, cabbage, and cheese. - Deli pastrami thinly sliced - Swiss cheese shredded - Arugula - Purple cabbage chopped
Place in the croutons and top with another layer of arugula, cabbage, and swiss cheese. Make sure this layer of cheese is thick enough to block the dressing from reaching the other ingredients.
Pour in the russian dressing on top of the cheese. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.
Optionally crumble a few potato chips on top of the salad when serving. - Potato Chips crumbled (optional), for serving
